terminology.lens: Reserve Lens for CGX handshake/representation/audience semantics. Internal architecture should use system, subsystem, function, capability, requirement, constraint, interface, configuration, inheritance, specialization or design objective as applicable.
terminology.interplanetary_supply_chain_simplified_g: Mark -> Luke -> John is an intentionally simplified functional skeleton, not a complete decomposition.

knowns.subject: Mark family
semantics: Mark family covers in-situ hardware that directly interacts with/touches an asteroid.
Mark I is the terrestrial asteroid-analogue test.
Mark 1P is a physical/sectional promotional exemplar of internal RFS/EMFF interaction.
Mark II is the first operational design and a legitimate historical engineering generation.
Mark III is the comprehensive revised/current operational architecture.
Mark IV is intentionally reserved for a future substantive high-capacity/growth architecture; do not proliferate IIIA/IIIB-style identities by default.
Mark V is a distinct Mark-family unit/function; its numeral is an identity, not merely a sequential software-style revision.

knowns.subject: Luke family
semantics: Luke is the transport/distribution node hardware family for resources within the interplanetary supply chain; it is not currently scoped as a general crew/capsule relay.
Luke family membership is not defined by in-situ operation or one particular relay geometry.
Luke 1P is promotional/demonstrative, analogous in role to Mark 1P.
Luke I and Luke II are closely related operational designs with different capacity.
Luke III is deliberately reserved, analogous to Mark IV, for future high-capacity/deeper-understanding development.
Luke IV is the terrestrial/geostationary Mag-Lev station/node identity; exact architecture remains governed by owning source/canon.

Apostle is the same underlying hardware family with a distinct primary protection/corridor functional designation. Luke-configured and Apostle-configured hardware may perform each other's functions where actual configuration/capacity permits.
Toroidal geometry is an implementation/configuration property and must not be used as the defining identity of Luke.

knowns.subject: John
semantics: John is the processing/manufacturing node side of the interplanetary supply chain, distinct from Mark mining/asteroid interaction and Luke transport/distribution.
John should be treated as an expandable in-space laboratory/manufacturing/processing capability rather than hard-set to one station form.
Cold-welding/consolidation during extraction/transport preparation is not intrinsically a John function; John transforms received material/feedstock into useful processed/manufactured state.

knowns.subject: Project C / Matthew
semantics: Project C remains an active debris-mitigation design objective/operational concern; it must not be forced into a current standalone Matthew hardware family.
The original Matthew/interstage electromagnetic debris-removal implementation remains provenance.

Newer shared infrastructure, especially suitable orbital/geostationary Luke capability, may satisfy Project C debris interaction/control/re-entry functions subject to engineering/orbital-dynamics/safety validation.
Superseding an implementation must not discard the original design objective or reasoning.

knowns.subject: Project P / Apostle
semantics: Project P/Protect is historical programme lineage/design driver; Apostle remains an active protection/corridor functional designation.
Current understanding allows Apostle and Luke functions to share the same hardware family and be cross-used where configuration/capacity permits.
This does not close future Frontier for new protection-specific hardware, functions or systems.

knowns.subject: InterSol
semantics: InterSol remains an active current project identity.
InterSol remains primarily a terrestrial physical hub.
Historical 2023 InterSol material is provenance, not sole current authority; current CGX/Drive InterSol canon controls after verified successor reconciliation.

knowns.subject: Interplanetary Supply Chain Systems
semantics: Project MD is historical lineage for the modern Interplanetary Supply Chain Systems identity.
As an intentional oversimplification: Mark = asteroid interaction/mining; Luke = resource transport/distribution; John = processing/manufacturing.

Do not treat shared technologies/capabilities such as RFS, EMFF, Free Flow, Solar Hull, Cognigrex, geometry/metrology, energy, communications, telemetry, autonomy, QA, fault handling or provenance as duplicated project-owned payloads when canonical shared capability/reference semantics suffice.

knowns.subject: CGX consolidation/deduplication
semantics: Separate semantics from data.
Separate independently authoritative data from dependent/derived/inherited/calculated/transformed/projected data.
Define shared capabilities once at the highest appropriate reusable scope and selectively inherit/specialize them.
Avoid duplicate files/data payloads for consumers; use canonical objects, relations, transforms, inheritance and explicit projections/replicas with authority/synchronisation rules.
Translate founder clarification into existing CGX semantic primitives and deltas rather than creating a secondary task architecture.

unresolved_or_heavy_pass: Exact engineering dimensions/configuration/capacity distinctions remain source/evidence work.
Whether non-contact field-only asteroid interaction satisfies the Mark family boundary remains unresolved unless owning canon already resolves it.
Physical instance identity/configuration/service-history rules remain implementation work.
Mark IV and Luke III promotion remain future design/founder gates.
John detailed capability decomposition, material-object state package and manufacturing envelopes remain heavy-pass work.
InterSol current detailed facilities/stages/interfaces must be reconciled from current owning CGX/Drive canon before historical sources.
Project C controlled re-entry concepts require orbital-dynamics, conjunction, regulatory, safety and empirical validation before operational claims.
